name: Bedburg-Hau (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided horizontally blue over yellow, with a yellow tau cross on the blue and a red cross-shaped house mark on the yellow, the figures of the municipal arms of Bedburg-Hau.
history: Municipal flag of Bedburg-Hau; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
